claim_statement: Royalty statements are due within 30 days after the end of each calendar quarter, whether or not royalties are due.

source_documents.document_text: Section 7.2 Royalty Statements. Within forty-five (45) days after the end of each calendar quarter, Licensee shall deliver to Licensor a royalty statement for that quarter, whether or not any royalties are due.

Section 2. Replacement of Section 7.2. Section 7.2 is deleted and replaced with the following: ‘Within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter, Licensee shall deliver to Licensor a royalty statement for that quarter, whether or not any royalties are due.’

Section 1. Quarterly Statements. For each calendar quarter, Licensee shall deliver its royalty statement to Licensor within forty-five (45) days after the quarter ends, whether or not any royalties are due. This letter supplements the Patent License Agreement.

analysis_rationale: The amendment supports the claimed 30-day deadline and expressly replaces Section 7.2. The Quarterly Reporting Letter states a 45-day deadline for the same reporting obligation but does not specify how that term relates to the amendment. The documents therefore provide inconsistent deadlines without enough information to resolve which controls.
evidence_gaps_or_conflicts: The Amendment sets a 30-day deadline, while the Quarterly Reporting Letter sets a 45-day deadline for quarterly royalty statements.

The Quarterly Reporting Letter says it supplements the agreement but does not state whether it modifies or supersedes the amendment; the provided text does not establish the documents' relative effective dates or priority.
supporting_evidence_quotes: Within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter, Licensee shall deliver to Licensor a royalty statement for that quarter, whether or not any royalties are due.
For each calendar quarter, Licensee shall deliver its royalty statement to Licensor within forty-five (45) days after the quarter ends, whether or not any royalties are due.
This letter supplements the Patent License Agreement.
supporting_clause_references: Amendment to Patent License Agreement, Section 2 (Replacement of Section 7.2)

claim_statement: The licensee owes a running royalty of 4% of Net Sales of Licensed Products in each calendar quarter.

source_documents.document_text:
Section 1.8 Net Sales. ‘Net Sales’ means the gross amounts invoiced by Licensee or its Affiliates for sales of Licensed Products to unaffiliated customers, less customary trade discounts, credits for returned products, and separately stated sales taxes.

Section 5.1 Royalty Rate. Licensee shall pay Licensor a running royalty equal to four percent (4%) of Net Sales of Licensed Products in each calendar quarter.

analysis_rationale: Section 5.1 expressly sets the running royalty at four percent of Net Sales for each calendar quarter. Section 1.8 defines the contractual royalty base, so the claim accurately states both the rate and the base used in the agreement.
